urdu: کون سے دن کو کراچی سے کوٹری کی ریلوے لائن کا افتتاح ہوا؟
english: On which date was the railway line from Karachi to Kotri inaugurated?
roman_1: Kon se din ko Karachi se Kotri ki railway line ka iftitah hua?
roman_2: Kaun se din ko Karachi se Kotri ki railway line ka iftitah hua?
roman_3: Kis din ko Karachi se Kotri ki railway line ka iftitah hua?
